image_description: An interior view of a rustic, older-style sawmill or lumber processing workshop. The scene is dominated by heavy, green-painted industrial machinery, specifically a large bandsaw with a massive flywheel on the right and a motor assembly on the left. To the right, there are neat stacks of processed lumber planks leaning against a wooden wall. In the background, additional machinery and raw logs are visible. The floor is dirt or concrete covered in sawdust and wood debris. The lighting is dim and artificial, suggesting an indoor environment.
